tray.placement_region: existing placement coordinate only; no tray collision geometry added

assumptions: The active HEAL collision meshes and MuJoCo signed geom distances are the geometry authority.
A 0.75 mm minimum margin is selected because the nominal gripper-to-table geometric gap is only a few millimetres; it is a simulation threshold, not a hardware safety rating.
The cube is released with TCP 20 mm higher than the original grasp contact height; using the modeled 130 mm wrist-to-pad offset, this yields an estimated 25 mm cube drop to the table surface.
Path checks sample 25 points on each planned smooth joint interpolation, so collisions between samples may be missed.
The held cube follows a fixed TCP-relative transform only in kinematic path checks; the actual MuJoCo grasp remains contact-based and is monitored during execution.

During close, held-object, and release kinematic checks, cube-to-gripper geom distances are excluded because the cube is intentionally nested in the finger envelope and the rigid hold proxy produced mesh overlap not present in recorded actual contacts; runtime MuJoCo contacts on non-excluded gripper geoms still trigger an abort.
Unsafe segments are rejected. No arbitrary obstacle or tray geometry is introduced and no general detour search is claimed.

clearance_policy.precheck: 25 sampled points on the same smooth joint interpolation used for execution
clearance_policy.runtime_guard: after each physics step, abort next control update if unexpected clearance is below margin or unexpected actual contact occurs
clearance_policy.held_cube_model: during lift/transfer/lower path checks, rigid TCP-to-cube transform captured after close is used; actual physical state is separately monitored each step

collision_audit.measurement_scope: post-step scene monitor; exact mj_geomDistance query for each listed geom pair at every physics step
collision_audit.contact_observation_definition: one pair observation per physics step with a MuJoCo contact record
collision_audit.distinct_contact_event_definition: transition into dist<=0 for a geom pair after a step without that pair in actual contact

expected_contact_exclusions.cube_geom<->worktable: allowed during approach, descend, close_gripper, lower_place, release, and retreat; during lift only while the cube remains within 6 mm of its geometric support height; transfer-phase table contact is unexpected
expected_contact_exclusions.cube_geom<->finger surfaces: left/right pad boxes and left/right follower tongue meshes; allowed phases close_gripper, lift, transfer, lower_place, release; counted separately
expected_contact_exclusions.tray: no tray geometry exists; no tray contacts or clearances are measured

collision_audit.collision_avoidance_enforcement_scope: sampled segment-clearance rejection plus runtime clearance/contact abort; not a general planner

cases.active_avoidance_scope: sampled waypoint-segment validation plus runtime abort guard; no general obstacle detour search or collision-constrained IK
